title: 二百十七番
mood: crushed, deadpan and bored out of its mind
subject: four hours on a ward office bench holding number ticket 217
caption: Japanese sludge and drone doom. Downtuned, fuzz-saturated guitar and bass through stacked amps, chords left to ring out into feedback; slow, heavy live drums with huge crash swells and long gaps between hits; a feedback drone section with no fixed meter; one sudden burst into a fast hardcore-punk tempo in the bridge before collapsing back to the crawl. Massive, loud and murky, guitars wall-to-wall, the voice distant and drenched in reverb. Male voice, low monotone chanting of short phrases, breaking into shouts in the fast burst. 60 BPM, C minor. Crushed, deadpan and bored out of its mind. No clean melodic chorus, no growled death-metal vocals, no shoegaze shimmer, no blast beats, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - short, one downtuned fuzz chord left to ring into feedback]

[Verse 1]
区役所 二階
番号札 二百十七番
画面は 百五十二
あと 六十五人

[Chorus]
呼ばれない
呼ばれない
長椅子に 背中が 沈む

[Verse 2]
窓の外が 昼になる
自販機が 低く 唸る
百八十 百八十一
隣の人は 寝た

[Chorus]
呼ばれない
呼ばれない
蛍光灯が 一本 点滅してる

[Bridge - sudden burst into fast hardcore-punk tempo, shouted]
二百十七番の方
三番窓口へ
印鑑 お持ちですか
持ってない

[Outro - back to the slow crawl, feedback drone, last chord rings out]
明日の朝
八時半に 並ぶ
